allocation.decision: Set after materials/assessment coverage and prerequisite review; no automatic eight-lesson default.

prerequisites: Distinguish a directly recorded observation from an interpretation; diagnose this before inference tasks.
materials_plan: Printed observation/evidence cards with competing explanations and independently defensible inferences.
Named, cited career/source summaries and a career-chart template; supply print access where devices are unavailable.
Environment/technology case cards, data collection/analysis sheet and isolated final evidence set.
solutions_plan: For each inference separate observation, claim, evidence and limits; allow alternative justified inferences.
Verify career claims against named public primary sources at authoring time; cite exact supporting material.

assessment_plan.a: Explain the learning area using a fresh case.
assessment_plan.b: Explain links to life, environment and technology using evidence.
assessment_plan.c: Identify and justify career links using supplied source information.
assessment_plan.d: Make and evaluate an inference from unfamiliar observations/data.
assessment_plan.e: Record a reasoned personal appreciation/action; label attitude evidence as formative where appropriate.

review_focus: Career chart is not a substitute for scientific-process evidence.
Check source attribution and usable non-digital resources.
